title: Orbit
description: A 4-second seamless 3D loop: a chrome sphere inside three spinning neon rings, built from a bpy script and rendered with Eevee on the GPU.

requires.why: encodes the frames with the fastest encoder
reads the finished video for the report

render.engine_command: blender -b --factory-startup -P runtime/blender_driver.py -- --scene src/scene.py --width 1920 --height 1080 --fps 24 --frames 96 --engine eevee && ffmpeg -i .lr-work/frames/frame_%06d.png <fastest encoder> orbit.mp4
